title: GraphTGI: an attention-based graph embedding model for predicting TF-target gene interactions.
authors: Du, Zhi-Hua; Wu, Yang-Han; Huang, Yu-An; Chen, Jie; Pan, Gui-Qing; Hu, Lun; You, Zhu-Hong; Li, Jian-Qiang
one_liner_zh: 该文用图注意力自编码器预测TF-靶基因互作，虽涉及TF-DNA调控关系，但主要基于网络链接预测而非三维结合机制，方法可迁移但深度有限。
abstract: MOTIVATION: Interaction between transcription factor (TF) and its target genes establishes the knowledge foundation for biological researches in transcriptional regulation, the number of which is, however, still limited by biological techniques. Existing computational methods relevant to the prediction of TF-target interactions are mostly proposed for predicting binding sites, rather than directly predicting the interactions. To this end, we propose here a graph attention-based autoencoder model to predict TF-target gene interactions using the information of the known TF-target gene interaction network combined with two sequential and chemical gene characters, considering that the unobserved interactions between transcription factors and target genes can be predicted by learning the pattern of the known ones. To the best of our knowledge, the proposed model is the first attempt to solve this problem by learning patterns from the known TF-target gene interaction network. RESULTS: In this paper, we formulate the prediction task of TF-target gene interactions as a link prediction problem on a complex knowledge graph and propose a deep learning model called GraphTGI, which is composed of a graph attention-based encoder and a bilinear decoder. We evaluated the prediction performance of the proposed method on a real dataset, and the experimental results show that the proposed model yields outstanding performance with an average AUC value of 0.8864 +/- 0.0057 in the 5-fold cross-validation. It is anticipated that the GraphTGI model can effectively and efficiently predict TF-target gene interactions on a large scale. AVAILABILITY: Python code and the datasets used in our studies are made available at https://github.com/YanghanWu/GraphTGI.
abstract_zh: 动机：转录因子（transcription factor, TF）与其靶基因之间的相互作用为转录调控的生物学研究奠定了知识基础，然而其数量仍受限于生物技术。现有的与TF-靶基因相互作用预测相关的计算方法大多用于预测结合位点，而非直接预测相互作用。为此，我们在此提出一种基于图注意力的自编码器模型，利用已知TF-靶基因相互作用网络的信息，结合两种序列和化学基因特征，来预测TF-靶基因相互作用，考虑到未观察到的转录因子与靶基因之间的相互作用可以通过学习已知相互作用的模式来预测。据我们所知，所提出的模型是首次尝试通过从已知TF-靶基因相互作用网络中学习模式来解决此问题。结果：在本文中，我们将TF-靶基因相互作用的预测任务表述为复杂知识图谱上的链接预测问题，并提出了一种名为GraphTGI的深度学习模型，该模型由基于图注意力的编码器和双线性解码器组成。我们在真实数据集上评估了所提出方法的预测性能，实验结果表明，该模型在5折交叉验证中表现出色，平均AUC值为0.8864 ± 0.0057。预期GraphTGI模型能够有效且高效地大规模预测TF-靶基因相互作用。可用性：本研究中使用的Python代码和数据集可在https://github.com/YanghanWu/GraphTGI获取。
